export const CALENDARS = [

  { id: 'focus', name: 'Focus', color: '#42b883' },

export type CalendarId = (typeof CALENDARS)[number]['id'];

export const colorOf = (id: CalendarId) => CALENDARS.find((calendar) => calendar.id === id)!.color;

export interface CalendarEvent {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  calendar: CalendarId;
  /** `null`: not planned yet, a task in the side panel. */
  day: Day | null;
  /** Minutes from midnight; `null`: all day, or not planned. */
  start: number | null;
  /** Minutes. Kept all day and unplanned too: back in the hours, the event has its length again. */
  duration: number;
}

/** Where an event is: at a time on a day, all day on a day, or nowhere yet. */
export type Place = Pick<CalendarEvent, 'day' | 'start'>;

/** A week of events around `monday` (and next week's standups), plus tasks to plan. */
function seed(monday: Day): CalendarEvent[] {
  const events: CalendarEvent[] = [];

      start: at === null ? null : at * 60,
      duration,

  add('Client demo', 'work', 2, 14);

  add('Retro', 'work', 4, 11);

}

/** What changed, for the toast and for undo. */
function describe(event: CalendarEvent, to: Place): string {
  if (to.day === null) return `“${event.title}” is back in Unscheduled`;
  if (to.start === null) return `“${event.title}” is all day on ${shortWeekday(to.day)}`;
  const when = `${shortWeekday(to.day)} ${clock(to.start)}`;
  return event.day === null ? `Scheduled “${event.title}” for ${when}` : `Moved “${event.title}” to ${when}`;

/**
 * The calendar's state, shared by its components: the events, the calendars switched off,
 * the event being named, and an undo history. Every change goes through `change()`.
 */
export function createCalendar(today: Day) {
  const events = ref<CalendarEvent[]>(seed(mondayOf(today)));
  /** Calendars switched off in the side panel: their events are left out everywhere. */
  const hidden = reactive(new Set<CalendarId>());
  /** The event whose title is being typed: a new one. */
  const editing = ref<string | null>(null);
  /** The events before each change, and what the change was. */
  const history = shallowRef<Array<{ before: CalendarEvent[]; text: string }>>([]);
  /** The last change, for the toast. `id` tells two changes with the same text apart. */
  const notice = shallowRef<{ id: number; text: string; undoable: boolean } | null>(null);

  const shown = computed(() => events.value.filter((event) => !hidden.has(event.calendar)));
  /** Where new events go: the first calendar shown, so they don't vanish into one switched off. */
  const fresh = computed<CalendarId>(() => CALENDARS.find(({ id }) => !hidden.has(id))?.id ?? 'work');
  const tasks = computed(() => shown.value.filter((event) => event.day === null));
  const on = (day: Day) => shown.value.filter((event) => event.day === day);
  const find = (id: Key) => events.value.find((event) => event.id === id);

  const change = (text: string, apply: () => void) => {
    history.value = [...history.value, { before: events.value.map((event) => ({ ...event })), text }];
    apply();
    notice.value = { id: (notice.value?.id ?? 0) + 1, text, undoable: true };
  };

  const undo = () => {
    const last = history.value.at(-1);
    if (!last) return;
    history.value = history.value.slice(0, -1);
    events.value = last.before;
    editing.value = null;
    notice.value = { id: (notice.value?.id ?? 0) + 1, text: `Undone: ${last.text}`, undoable: false };
  };

  /** To a time on a day, all day on a day (`start: null`), or back among the tasks (`day: null`). */
  const place = (id: Key, to: Place) => {
    const event = find(id);
    if (!event || (event.day === to.day && event.start === to.start)) return;
    change(describe(event, to), () => Object.assign(event, to));
  };

  const resize = (id: Key, to: { start: number; duration: number }) => {
    const event = find(id);
    if (!event || (event.start === to.start && event.duration === to.duration)) return;
    change(`“${event.title}” is now ${span(to.start, to.duration)}`, () => Object.assign(event, to));
  };

  let created = 0;
  /** A new event, named right away: its title is typed in place (`editing`). */
  const create = (day: Day, start: number, duration: number) => {
    const calendar = fresh.value;
    hidden.delete(calendar); // all of them were switched off
    const event: CalendarEvent = { id: `new-${++created}`, title: '', calendar, day, start, duration };
    change(`New event on ${shortWeekday(day)} ${span(start, duration)}`, () => events.value.push(event));
    editing.value = event.id;
  };

  /** Names a new event: part of its creation, which undo takes back as a whole. */
  const rename = (id: Key, title: string) => {
    const event = find(id);
    if (event) event.title = title.trim() || 'New event';
    editing.value = null;
  };

  const remove = (id: Key) => {
    const event = find(id);
    if (!event) return;
    change(`Deleted “${event.title}”`, () => events.value.splice(events.value.indexOf(event), 1));
  };

  return {
    hidden,
    fresh,
    editing,
    notice,
    tasks,
    on,
    canUndo: computed(() => history.value.length > 0),
    undo,
    place,
    resize,
    create,
    rename,
    remove,
  };
}

export const CALENDAR: InjectionKey<Calendar> = Symbol('calendar');

export const useCalendar = () => inject(CALENDAR)!;

const now = useNow({ scheduler: (tick) => useIntervalFn(tick, 30_000) });
const today = computed(() => toDay(now.value));
const minutes = computed(() => now.value.getHours() * 60 + now.value.getMinutes());

/** The day the view is built around: its week, or on a phone the three days from it. */
const focus = ref(today.value);
const days = computed(() => {
  const first = count.value === 7 ? mondayOf(focus.value) : focus.value;
  return Array.from({ length: count.value }, (_, index) => first + index);
});

const period = computed(() => {
  const first = days.value[0]!;
  const last = days.value.at(-1)!;
  if (monthYear(first) === monthYear(last)) return count.value === 7 ? monthYear(first) : `${shortMonth(first)} ${year(first)}`;
  if (year(first) === year(last)) return `${shortMonth(first)} – ${shortMonth(last)} ${year(last)}`;
  return `${shortMonth(first)} ${year(first)} – ${shortMonth(last)} ${year(last)}`;
});

const createNow = () => {
  const isToday = days.value.includes(today.value);
  const start = isToday ? Math.min(Math.ceil((minutes.value + 1) / 30) * 30, DAY_MINUTES - 60) : 9 * 60;
  calendar.create(isToday ? today.value : days.value[0]!, start, 60);

  event.preventDefault();
  undo();

const toast = ref(false);

const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');

  const data = active.value?.data as DragData | undefined;

import type { Coordinates, Over } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import type { CalendarEvent, Place } from './calendar';
import { DAY_MINUTES, STEP, STEP_PX, clamp, clock, longWeekday, minutesAt, shortWeekday, span, type Day } from './time';

/** What a drop target is (its `data`): the hours of a day, a day's all-day cell, or the task list. */
export type Target = { kind: 'hours'; day: Day } | { kind: 'all-day'; day: Day } | { kind: 'tasks' };

/**
 * What a drag carries (its `data`): an event, the start or end edge of one, or empty time
 * pressed `from` px down a day.
 */
export type DragData =
  | { kind: 'event'; event: CalendarEvent }
  | { kind: 'edge'; event: CalendarEvent; edge: 'start' | 'end' }
  | { kind: 'new'; day: Day; from: number };

/** The height of an event's edges (Edge.vue), in px: the edge itself is in their middle. */
const EDGE_PX = 8;

/**
 * Where a drop on `over` would put the event. The overlay's label, the ghost in the day,
 * what screen readers hear and the drop itself all ask this, so they never disagree.
 * `position` is where the dragged box's top-left corner is in the target.
 */
export function placeOf(event: CalendarEvent, over: Over | null, position: Coordinates | null): Place | null {
  const target = over?.accepted ? (over.data as Target) : null;
  if (!target) return null;
  if (target.kind === 'tasks') return { day: null, start: null };
  if (target.kind === 'all-day') return { day: target.day, start: null };
  if (!position) return null;
  return { day: target.day, start: clamp(minutesAt(position.y), 0, DAY_MINUTES - event.duration) };
}

/** The event with one edge dragged to `position` (the edge's box in the day): at least a quarter of an hour long. */
export function resizeTo(event: CalendarEvent, edge: 'start' | 'end', position: Coordinates) {
  const start = event.start ?? 0;
  const end = start + event.duration;
  const at = clamp(minutesAt(position.y + EDGE_PX / 2), 0, DAY_MINUTES);
  if (edge === 'start') {
    const from = Math.min(at, end - STEP);
    return { start: from, duration: end - from };
  }
  return { start, duration: Math.max(at, start + STEP) - start };
}

/** The quarters of an hour between two points of a day, `from` the press `to` the pointer. */
export function rangeOf(from: number, to: number) {
  const start = clamp(Math.floor(Math.min(from, to) / STEP_PX) * STEP, 0, DAY_MINUTES - STEP);
  const end = clamp(Math.ceil(Math.max(from, to) / STEP_PX) * STEP, start + STEP, DAY_MINUTES);
  return { start, duration: end - start };
}

/** "Tue 10:30 – 11:15", "Tue · All day", "Unscheduled": for the overlay. */
export function labelOf(place: Place, duration: number): string {
  if (place.day === null) return 'Unscheduled';
  if (place.start === null) return `${shortWeekday(place.day)} · All day`;
  return `${shortWeekday(place.day)} ${span(place.start, duration)}`;
}

/** "Tuesday, 10:30 to 11:15", "Tuesday, all day", "Unscheduled": for screen readers. */
export function spokenOf(place: Place, duration: number): string {
  if (place.day === null) return 'Unscheduled';
  if (place.start === null) return `${longWeekday(place.day)}, all day`;
  return `${longWeekday(place.day)}, ${clock(place.start)} to ${clock(place.start + duration)}`;
}

/** A block of half an hour or less has room for one line; a quarter of an hour, for a small one. */
export const sizeOf = (duration: number) => (duration <= 15 ? 'tiny' : duration <= 30 ? 'short' : undefined);

export interface Slot {
  event: CalendarEvent;
  column: number;
  columns: number;
}

/**
 * Overlapping events go side by side: each takes the first column free when it starts, and
 * events that overlap one another, directly or through others, share the day's width.
 */
export function layoutDay(events: CalendarEvent[]): Slot[] {
  const sorted = [...events].sort((a, b) => a.start! - b.start! || b.duration - a.duration);
  const slots: Slot[] = [];
  let group: Slot[] = [];
  /** When each column of the group is free again. */
  let ends: number[] = [];

  for (const event of sorted) {
    const start = event.start!;
    // Everything so far has ended: the next group begins.
    if (ends.every((end) => end <= start)) {
      for (const slot of group) slot.columns = ends.length;
      group = [];
      ends = [];
    }
    let column = ends.findIndex((end) => end <= start);
    if (column === -1) column = ends.length;
    ends[column] = start + event.duration;
    const slot = { event, column, columns: 1 };
    group.push(slot);
    slots.push(slot);
  }
  for (const slot of group) slot.columns = ends.length;
  return slots;
}

export type Day = number;

const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;

/** The day a date falls on, where you are. */
export const toDay = (date: Date): Day => Math.round(Date.UTC(date.getFullYear(), date.getMonth(), date.getDate()) / DAY_MS);

/** A day as a date, to be read in UTC, as `toDay` wrote it. */
const dateOf = (day: Day) => new Date(day * DAY_MS);

/** 0 is Monday, 6 is Sunday. */
export const weekdayOf = (day: Day) => (dateOf(day).getUTCDay() + 6) % 7;
export const mondayOf = (day: Day): Day => day - weekdayOf(day);
export const dateNumber = (day: Day) => dateOf(day).getUTCDate();
export const isWeekend = (day: Day) => weekdayOf(day) >= 5;

/** The first day of the month `months` after the one `day` is in. */
export const firstOfMonth = (day: Day, months = 0): Day => {
  const date = dateOf(day);
  return Date.UTC(date.getUTCFullYear(), date.getUTCMonth() + months, 1) / DAY_MS;
};

/** ISO week number: week 1 has the year's first Thursday. */
export const weekNumber = (day: Day) => {
  const thursday = mondayOf(day) + 3;
  const january = Date.UTC(dateOf(thursday).getUTCFullYear(), 0, 1) / DAY_MS;
  return Math.floor((thursday - january) / 7) + 1;
};

const formatter = (options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions) => {
  const format = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { ...options, timeZone: 'UTC' });
  return (day: Day) => format.format(dateOf(day));
};

export const shortWeekday = formatter({ weekday: 'short' }); // Tue
export const longWeekday = formatter({ weekday: 'long' }); // Tuesday
export const shortMonth = formatter({ month: 'short' }); // Nov
export const year = formatter({ year: 'numeric' }); // 2026
export const monthYear = formatter({ month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }); // November 2026
export const fullDate = formatter({ weekday: 'long', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }); // Tuesday, November 3

// ─── The hours ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/** An hour is 48 px tall, and events snap to quarters of an hour: 12 px, a whole number. */
export const HOUR_PX = 48;
export const STEP = 15;
export const STEP_PX = (HOUR_PX * STEP) / 60;
export const DAY_MINUTES = 24 * 60;

export const toPx = (minutes: number) => (minutes * HOUR_PX) / 60;

/** The time `y` px down a day stands for, to the quarter of an hour. */
export const minutesAt = (y: number) => Math.round(y / STEP_PX) * STEP;

export const clamp = (value: number, min: number, max: number) => Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);

/** 9:05, 14:30 */
export const clock = (minutes: number) => `${Math.floor(minutes / 60)}:${String(minutes % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;

/** 10:30 – 11:15 */
export const span = (start: number, duration: number) => `${clock(start)} – ${clock(start + duration)}`;

/** 15m, 1h, 1h 30m */
export const formatDuration = (minutes: number) => {
  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
  const rest = minutes % 60;
  return [hours && `${hours}h`, rest && `${rest}m`].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
};

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onMounted, useTemplateRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { useResizeObserver } from '@vueuse/core';
import { makeDragArea, useDnD, useDnDMonitor, type Modifier } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import AllDayCell from './AllDayCell.vue';
import DayColumn from './DayColumn.vue';
import { placeOf, spokenOf, type DragData, type Target } from './placement';
import { HOUR_PX, STEP_PX, clock, dateNumber, shortWeekday, toPx, type Day } from './time';

/** The days in view, today, and the time now (minutes) for the line across the hours. */
const props = defineProps<{ days: Day[]; today: Day; minutes: number }>();
const scroller = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('scroller');
const grid = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('grid');
const heads = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('heads');
const { active, over, position } = useDnD();

/**
 * The hours' own modifier. Over the days, the dragged box moves by whole days, as many as the
 * pointer crossed (an event beside another keeps its place in the day), and its top snaps to
 * the quarters of an hour of the day it started in (`containerRect`, which follows the scroll).
 * It runs first, so `origin + transform` is the pointer.
 */
const snapToWeek: Modifier = ({ transform, overlayRect, containerRect, origin }) => {
  const days = grid.value?.getBoundingClientRect();
  if (!days || !containerRect) return transform;
  const width = days.width / props.days.length;
  const column = (x: number) => Math.floor((x - days.left) / width);
  const pointer = origin.x + transform.x;
  const x = pointer < days.left || pointer >= days.right ? transform.x : (column(pointer) - column(origin.x)) * width;
  const top = overlayRect.top - containerRect.top;
  return { x, y: transform.y + Math.round(top / STEP_PX) * STEP_PX - top };
};

// Rules for every drag that starts in the hours: an event, one of its edges, or empty time.
// The hours auto-scroll near their ends for any drag, from a narrower edge than the default:
// the all-day row right above them stays easy to reach.
makeDragArea(grid, { modifiers: [snapToWeek], autoScroll: { threshold: 0.12 } });

// Keyboard drags over the hours: up and down by a quarter of an hour (with Shift, an hour),
// left and right by a day. Elsewhere (the task list, the all-day row) the library's own
// moves apply.
useDnDMonitor({
  getKeyboardCoordinates: (key, { pointer, direction }) => {
    const hours = scroller.value;
    if ((over.value?.data as Target | undefined)?.kind !== 'hours' || !hours || !grid.value) return undefined;
    const dy = direction.y * STEP_PX * (key.shiftKey ? 4 : 1);
    const next = { x: pointer.x + direction.x * (grid.value.offsetWidth / props.days.length), y: pointer.y + dy };
    // Keyboard drags don't auto-scroll: near an end of the hours in view, the arrow scrolls
    // them instead, and the event goes on in time where it is on the screen.
    const view = hours.getBoundingClientRect();
    const canScroll = dy < 0 ? hours.scrollTop > 0 : hours.scrollTop + hours.clientHeight < hours.scrollHeight;
    if (canScroll && (next.y < view.top + HOUR_PX || next.y > view.bottom - HOUR_PX)) {
      hours.scrollTop += dy;
      return { x: next.x, y: pointer.y };
    }
    return next;
  },
});

/** For screen readers: where a keyboard drag would land, as the arrows move it. */
const spoken = computed(() => {
  const data = active.value?.data as DragData | undefined;
  if (active.value?.sensor !== 'keyboard' || data?.kind !== 'event') return '';
  const place = placeOf(data.event, over.value, position.value);
  return place ? spokenOf(place, data.event.duration) : '';
});

const todayAt = computed(() => props.days.indexOf(props.today));
/** "GMT+2", in the corner above the hours. */
const zone = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZoneName: 'shortOffset' })
  .formatToParts(new Date())
  .find((part) => part.type === 'timeZoneName')?.value;

// Open on the working day, or on now when today is in view and it is daytime.
let scrolled = 0;
onMounted(() => {
  const hours = scroller.value!;
  const day = props.minutes >= 7 * 60 && props.minutes <= 21 * 60;
  hours.scrollTop = toPx(todayAt.value >= 0 && day ? props.minutes : 8 * 60) - hours.clientHeight / 3;
  scrolled = hours.scrollTop;
});
// Moved elsewhere in the page (a full-screen view takes it to <body>), an element loses its
// scroll: the hours keep theirs.
const keepScroll = () => (scrolled = scroller.value!.scrollTop);
useResizeObserver(scroller, () => {
  if (scroller.value) scroller.value.scrollTop = scrolled;
});

// Turning the week, its days slide in from the side it went to.
watch(
  () => props.days[0]!,
  (first, before) => {
    if (matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
    const from = `translateX(${first > before ? 32 : -32}px)`;
    for (const element of [heads.value, grid.value]) {
      element?.animate([{ opacity: 0, transform: from }, { opacity: 1, transform: 'none' }], {
        duration: 280,
        easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)',
      });
    }
  },
);
</script>
